dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "--version"]
explanation: Requirements.txt includes fontTools and clang with recent stable versions. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, copies code, and defaults to showing Python version. Adjust CMD as needed for Proton-specific entry point.
